text_message: That bride just now was so beautiful!
Aw, I'm jealous! I wanna wear a dress like that!
A wedding dress, huh? The elegant design is rather captivating...
Riiight? ♪ You would look so good in one, Air Groove!
What do you say to bewitching everyone?
What kind of outfit are you planning on making me wear?
I'm sure there are others who would look good in a wedding dress too. For example, hm... how about Dober?
Yeah, true! But you know, I bet everyone would look good in one! ♪ There are so many different kinds of wedding dresses, after all!
Some look fit for a princess, and some are biiiig and poofy. ♪ I wonder who from the academy they'd suit?
...Stop letting your weird imagination run wild.
Stay tuned for Umamusume: Pretty Derby's newest story event—Racing Hearts Beauty in Bloom.
Take off in a twinkly dress. ☆
Check out the world's strongest racer! I'm peak! I'm power! I'm El—star of the Umamusume world!
You appear to be in good spirits, El. But being the star of one world doesn't necessarily mean you'd excel in others.
Qué?! Other what? Are you sayin' there are other worlds out there?!
No, not quite. I've heard that Tracen Academy has new machines that let you experience games in virtual reality.
For example... you could enter a kingdom of swords and sorcery.
Imagine exploring a fantasy world, with your own Umamusume body and abilities...
Oooooh! Kinda like an Umamusume isekai!
If I got isekai'd into a game world, I'd definitely be the Eternal Champion— the hero of the El-ell Saga!
C'mon Grass, we've gotta go check it out! It'll be like a mini vacation, and we can brawl our way to video game glory!
Oh, fine. I guess I'll have to go with you. I'd be too worried letting you go all on your own.
Next time on Umamusume: Pretty Derby—"Uma Quest: Epic Odyssey"!
Stay tuned for El's Condor punches and my healing magic! ♪
Hmm. There are so many different kinds of swimsuits nowadays.
No kidding! That orange one is so cute.
They have everything from sporty ones to the classic two-piece designs.
Ah, I love that one with the ribbons...
That one's nice! I bet you would look great in it!
You know, I think I saw someone picking out a new swimsuit from a magazine the other day...
I guess it's already swimsuit season, huh?
So it is. Come to think of it, I don't have anything fun planned for the summer.
Haha. Me neither. My training schedule is too packed for anything like that...
Next time on Umamusume: Pretty Derby—Beaches, Bathing Suits & Blazing Trails.
There'll be swimsuits, pools, and disco fever! ...Wait, disco fever?
